title: Boss Battle: The Morning Report
story: Management wants the incident summary before stand-up. Stand-up began seven minutes ago. Produce evidence that looks intentional.
objective: From /logs/incidents.log, create /reports/error-services.txt containing only the names of services with ERROR entries, one per line, alphabetically sorted with duplicates removed.
hints: Start by making the data smaller: keep only the ERROR lines before extracting service names.
grep ERROR incidents.log prints only the incident lines the report needs.
The service is the third whitespace-separated field on each ERROR line. awk '{print $3}' selects it.
sort orders the service names, uniq removes adjacent duplicates, and > writes the final stream to the report file.
Try: grep ERROR incidents.log | awk '{print $3}' | sort | uniq > /reports/error-services.txt
explanation: Pipelines connect one command's output to the next command's input. Redirection writes the final stream to a file. Small tools compose into a repeatable report without changing the source log.
